top_news.title: Stocks, Futures Rise on Nvidia Outlook; Oil Drops: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Nvidia Corp.’s bullish sales outlook lifted stocks and futures, bolstering optimism that this year’s rally in artificial intelligence shares has further to run. Oil extended its losses.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 27
top_news.summary: Oil edged lower after a choppy session in which traders weighed diplomatic progress in the Middle East against rising Russia-Ukraine tensions.

top_news.title: Malaysia Detains Ex-Treasury Chief Over Pilgrimage Fund Probe
top_news.summary: Malaysian authorities have detained a former Treasury secretary-general over a probe into mismanagement of Muslim pilgrimage fund Tabung Haji, according to the Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission.

top_news.title: Economists See RBA Rate Hike as Early as September After Hot CPI
top_news.summary: Australia’s hot inflation spurred economists from Goldman Sachs Group Inc. to Commonwealth Bank to predict another interest-rate increase as early as next month, abandoning expectations of no change for the remainder of the year.

top_news.title: Thai Yield Gap May Narrow as Tame Inflation Boosts Long Bonds
top_news.summary: Thailand’s yield curve may flatten as easing inflation and a slowing economy draw investor demand for longer-dated bonds, according to analysts.

top_news.title: Li Ka-shing Keeps $23 Billion Ask for Ports Despite Panama Loss
top_news.summary: Li Ka-shing’s CK Hutchison Holdings Ltd. expects to sell what remains of its global ports portfolio for its original $22.8 billion value, even after losing two Panama terminals that had been included, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_news.title: Mark Walter’s TWG Says ‘There Has Been No Fraud’
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." TWG Global, the holding company at the heart of Mark Walter’s empire, defended itself against what it called “multipronged attacks” on its business as regulators and US prosecutors continue to probe the firm. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Unrivaled CEO Discusses New Funding, Expansion
top_news.summary: Alex Bazzell, CEO and co-founder Unrivaled, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Unrivaled, the 3-on-3 women’s basketball league founded by WNBA stars Breanna Stewart and Napheesa Collier. The league, founded in 2023, now has a valuation of $650 million, nearly doubling from September 2025. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Power, Infrastructure At Center of Data-Center Deals
top_news.summary: Maria Goodpaster, Partner at McKinsey & Company, Kate Dorsey, Managing Director at Stonepeak, and Melissa Kalka, M&A, Private Equity Partner at Kirkland & Ellis, join Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals" to discuss data-center dealmaking.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Private Equity Firms Find a New Way to Ride Out Cash Crunch
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Laura Benitez joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Private equity managers are using structured equity deals to placate investors frustrated by a lack of cash returns, as many firms struggle to exit investments and send money back to investors. (Source: Bloomberg)
